title: Downloaded PPTX and PDF export docs are not valid files
description: The downloaded pptx and pdf docs are not valid files (mock byte payloads).
cause: Export deck buttons trigger dummy blob downloads without client-side or server-side PDF/PPTX compilation.
plan: Implement valid client-side PDF export via jspdf / print-to-pdf and real PPTX compilation via pptxgenjs / server python script.

title: Executive Summary expansion with decision-first synthesis and audio briefing
description: The exec summary is a bit bare in legacy baseline.
cause: Baseline v1 lacked Top 3 action items, sleeper leading indicators, schedule squeeze alerts, and audio briefing.
plan: Maintain and expand the Gemini 3.5 Pro Executive Decision Briefing with Top 3 Action items, Sleeper Outlier (Ref 1.15), and NotebookLM audio.
resolution_notes: Enriched executive briefing with Gemini 3.5 Pro decision synthesis, Top 3 Action items, Sleeper Outlier (Ref 1.15), and Australian NotebookLM podcast player.

title: ATO-C Security Gate status text 'AMBER' is styled in green font color
description: On Executive Summary tab 4-KPI banner, the ATO-C Security Gate status displays a yellow dot but has the text 'AMBER' rendered in green font color (text-emerald-400) instead of amber/yellow (text-amber-400).
cause: Tailwind color class text-emerald-400 was hardcoded on the AMBER label span.
plan: Update class to text-amber-400 with matching yellow badge styling and verify automated test.

title: Make Gemini Executive Summary Prompt editable in Dashboard Settings
description: Provide an interactive Prompt Editor in the Dashboard Settings / Workspace Sync modal allowing users to view, customize, and tweak the Gemini executive synthesis and podcast prompt templates live.
cause: Prompt template is currently stored in static file project_dash/prompts/exec_summary_prompt.md.
plan: Add settings modal editor tab with prompt textarea, live token counter, and Save & Regenerate API endpoint.

title: Click-through on 5x5 heatmap cells does not filter risks as expected
description: Clicking into individual cells on the 5x5 Risk Heatmap Matrix on Tab 2 does not filter the risk items in the Live Explorer or navigate correctly.
cause: Cell click handler highlightHeatmapCell coordinates need exact visual cell binding and smooth filter scroll.
plan: Reconcile highlightHeatmapCell(l, c, score) to highlight active grid cell, expand filtered risk list, and support 1-click unfilter.

title: Burndown chart is empty on Performance Trends tab
description: On the Performance Trends tab (Tab 4), the Inherent vs Residual Risk Burndown / Burnup line chart is rendered blank or empty.
cause: Canvas element container height collapsed or Chart.js instance initialization timing issue.
plan: Set fixed container height and ensure renderTrendsCharts() binds datasets across Weekly, Bi-Weekly, and Monthly granularity.

title: Time Machine weekly selector chips across orange header bar
description: In Time Machine view, list available historical weeks (Week 22, Week 23, Week 24, Week 25, Week 26, etc.) directly across the top of the orange header bar as clickable chips or a horizontal scroll track to allow instant 1-click scrubbing and flicking between reporting weeks.
cause: Time Machine selector is currently a vertical modal list rather than a top horizontal scrubbing bar.
plan: Embed a horizontal week chip ribbon across the orange Time Machine banner for immediate 1-click historical time travel.

title: Clicking dashboard header title / logo navigates back to Executive Summary home
description: Clicking the main header title ('Risk and Issue Interactive Dashboard') or application logo should act as a standard home button, switching directly back to the Executive Summary (Tab 1) and updating browser history.
cause: Header title is static non-clickable text without an onclick handler.
plan: Add cursor-pointer and onclick="switchTab('exec-briefing')" with window.scrollTo(0,0).

title: Remove / Deprecate Executive Summary tone selection buttons
description: The Tone selection buttons ('Exec Concise', 'Technical', 'Steering Comm') on the Executive Briefing card do not add value and should be permanently removed in favor of a single authoritative exception-first standard.
cause: Tone toggles create unnecessary cognitive overhead for executive readers.
plan: Permanently deprecate tone selector buttons across UI, prompt templates, and JS logic.
resolution_notes: Permanently deprecated and removed tone buttons from the executive synthesis card, prompt template, and JS logic in favor of a single exception-first standard.

title: Future FR: In-Dashboard Data Entry & Risk Logging Form
description: Future enhancement to allow users to author and submit new risk statements and issues directly from the dashboard UI with validation and sync to Google Sheets.
cause: Placeholder container lacked complete interactive input form and local storage / API submit handler.
plan: Build complete structured form (ID, Risk Name, Owner, Category, Driver Ref, Inherent L/C, Residual L/C, Treatment Plan) with live validation and append to LIVE_RISKS.

title: Overhaul Performance Trends tab: reconcile with dash_v1 and Drive weekly snapshots
description: Review and enhance the Performance Trends tab (Tab 4) by benchmarking against dash_v1 and parsing the multi-week historical reporting data in Drive to concisely synthesize risk velocity, burndown trajectories, and delivery performance trends.
cause: Trends tab lacked deep multi-week data binding against actual historical Drive snapshots (Weeks 22–26).
plan: Parse weekly snapshots from Drive/JSON, calculate exact weekly net risk velocity and mitigation deltas, and render concise charts.

title: Unify Risk & Issue architecture across both Dashboards and Registers
description: Harmonize the taxonomy and views so that both Risks and Issues have equal representation across visual dashboards (Issue severity/status breakdown alongside the 5x5 Risk Heatmap) and tabular registers (unified/toggleable Risk & Issue Explorer and Ledgers), eliminating the asymmetry of having a 'Risk Dashboard' but an 'Issue Register'.
cause: Asymmetric tab taxonomy ('Risk Dashboard' vs 'Issue Register') created cognitive friction.
plan: Harmonize Tab 2 & 3 into a cohesive 'Risk & Issue Dashboard' and 'Risk & Issue Explorer & Ledger' with seamless sub-tab toggle.

title: Clean up obsolete, unused, and legacy temporary files in project_dash directory
description: Audit and clean up legacy temporary scripts, unused prototype assets, and stale files in the project_dash directory to keep the workspace lightweight, organized, and clean.
cause: Rapid iterative development left behind scratch files, orphan zips, and duplicate scripts in project_dash/.
plan: Audit project_dash directory, remove redundant temporary files, clean up dash_v1/tmp/, and retain only core single-stack assets.
resolution_notes: Purged legacy Streamlit prototypes (app.py, app_phase2.py, .streamlit/), old prototype directory (dash_v1/), and unused React/Vite scaffolding (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts), standardizing 100% on the single-product vanilla HTML5 / Tailwind / Chart.js architecture.

title: Interactive Google Sheet & Drive Folder switcher with human-readable names
description: Provide a streamlined interface in Dashboard Settings / Sync modal to easily point the dashboard to a new Google Sheet or Drive Folder. Rather than displaying opaque hexadecimal Drive/Sheet IDs, display clear human-readable names (e.g. 'F-DSE Master Risk Register (Week 26)', 'F-DSE Weekly Reporting Packs') with 1-click folder/sheet selection and validation.
cause: Sync modal displays technical Drive file IDs rather than human-readable document titles and folder aliases.
plan: Build friendly name-based Sheet & Folder picker in Settings modal with live connection test and active source indicators.
